jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in project planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination, particularly at the level expected for professional project managers leading cross-functional teams and complex technical or scientific initiatives.

**Role overview:**

* In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your project management and organizational expertise.
* No prior AI experience is required.
* These projects will help you explore how AI can improve workflow planning, communication, and process automation across professional and technical environments.

**What does day-to-day look like:**

* Design and solve real-world project management and coordination scenarios to test AI reasoning.
* Write clear, structured explanations covering project scheduling, risk assessment, resource allocation, and performance tracking.
* Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with industry project management frameworks.
* Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of PMI’s PMBOK, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Program Coordinator, or Project Management Specialist.
* Background in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project) and frameworks (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall).
* Excellent English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain structured processes clearly.

**Perks of freelancing with Turing:**

* Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
* Fully remote work environment.
* Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full-time.
* Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension.

**What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:**

* Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.
* Trade secrets or internal company or university data.
* Specific client information or case details.
* Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

**About Turing:**

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Senior IT Project Manager leads the execution of complex IT transformation programs, ensuring successful delivery against scope, timeline, budget, and quality objectives. Orchestrates cross-functional teams, governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and vendor performance to drive predictable outcomes and business adoption across strategic initiatives.

Apply now for the position of **Senior IT Project Manager** and lead the successful delivery of strategic Diagnostics IT transformation projects across customer, product, supply chain, and service platforms (e.g., CRM, ERP, PLM, ISTM).

**Your role:**

* You will lead complex, cross-functional IT projects (e.g., CRM implementations and rollouts, SAP migrations), ensuring delivery on scope, timeline, budget, and quality.
* You will drive end-to-end project execution, including planning, resource orchestration, risk management, and dependency resolution across multiple workstreams and stakeholders.
* You will act as the primary interface between business, IT, and external partners, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and delivery outcomes.
* You will drive senior stakeholder engagement, including steering committees and executive alignment.
* You will manage and steer external system integrators and vendors, ensuring high-quality delivery, accountability, and adherence to defined standards.
* You will establish and enforce project governance, including status reporting, decision forums, escalation management, and milestone tracking.
* You will proactively identify and mitigate risks, issues, and interdependencies, ensuring transparency and timely resolution across all program layers.
* You will ensure successful business adoption by aligning delivery with end-to-end process requirements and change management needs.
* You will drive continuous improvements across project delivery, including lessons learned, best practices, and scalable delivery approaches.

**Your expertise:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required; a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* 8-10+ years of experience in IT project/program management, leading large-scale, complex transformation initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Proven track record in delivering major programs such as CRM (e.g., Salesforce), ERP (e.g., SAP), or ITSM transformations, including global rollouts.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT landscapes, including system integrations, data dependencies, and cross-platform impacts.
* Hands-on experience managing external system integrators and multi-vendor environments, with strong commercial and delivery steering capabilities.
* Deep expertise in program governance, risk management, financial tracking, and stakeholder management at senior levels.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes (e.g., Lead-to-Cash, Service, Finance) and their translation into IT delivery.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and communicate complex topics clearly.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with tight timelines and significant dependencies.
* Experience in agile and hybrid delivery models, with the ability to operate across both structured projects and iterative implementations.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

D2D Consulting is the go-to resource for project management and software implementation services. Providing customized development, quality assurance testing, data validation, comprehensive training and help desk support, D2D Consulting offers full end-to-end management and delivery of our client’s processes. D2D Consulting distinguishes themselves with a unique combination of deep business operations knowledge and technology expertise. As a result, we have become a trusted business partner who shares our clients’ vision, achieving a 100% client retention rate and 100% on-time and on-budget project implementation.

**Job Description**

D2D Consulting is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Project Manager to support our Project Management Office (PMO). This role is essential to keeping projects running smoothly - from managing deliverables and tracking timelines to coordinating client communications and maintaining accurate documentation. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced consulting environment, anticipates needs before they become issues, and enjoys being the glue that holds projects together.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Planning, executing, and closing projects across multiple clients
* Track project deliverables, milestones, timelines, and dependencies to ensure on-time execution
* Coordinate internal teams, vendors, and clients to keep everyone aligned and informed
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project plans, status reports, meeting notes, and risk logs
* Monitor project risks and issues, escalate concerns as needed, and help implement mitigation strategies
* Facilitate client communications, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and following up on action items
* Assist with resource coordination and workload tracking
* Ensure projects follow PMO standards, processes, and best practices
* Support continuous improvement efforts within the PMO

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of project management experience, including experience in a client-facing role.
* Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment
* Proficiency with project management tools, with an understanding of PMO frameworks and project governance
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office

**Soft Skills**

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients and internal teams
* Proactive mindset with a natural ability to anticipate needs and solve problems before they escalate
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven consulting environment
* Confident communicator who can translate project details clearly to different audiences
* High level of accountability, ownership, and follow-through
* Calm under pressure with strong judgment when priorities shift
* Collaborative team player who values structure, process, and continuous improvement

**D2D Consultant Expectations**

D2D consultants are expected to maintain the highest standards of professionalism, communication, and ethical conduct. These expectations include:

*Professionalism and Conduct*

* Present a clean, neat, and tasteful appearance appropriate to your role whenever representing D2D, whether in person or virtually.
* Be prepared for the workday and arrive on time for scheduled work, meetings, and events. If tardiness or absence is unavoidable, notify both your D2D supervisor and the client as soon as possible. Frequent or unexcused absences or lateness may result in disciplinary action.
* Always demonstrate ethical behavior, including safeguarding confidential information and refraining from theft, negligence, destruction, or unauthorized removal or misuse of D2D or client property.
* Ensure that participation in outside professional organizations does not interfere with job performance or client obligations.

*Communication and Reporting*

* Communicate proactively with clients and D2D management regarding timelines, deliverables, delays, and project status. Consultants are required to provide status updates to their direct manager at least weekly.
* Submit all work time into the time management system by the end of each Friday to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.

*Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion*

* Uphold D2D’s commitment to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment.
* Do not engage in or tolerate discrimination, harassment, or unfair treatment based on race, skin color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), religion, disability, age, or genetic information.

*Employee Benefits*

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance – comprehensive coverage to protect your well-being
* Paid Time Off – vacation, sick days, and full office closures on all major holidays
* Commission Opportunities – earn additional income through qualifying sales
* Holistic Support – access to caregiver programs, wellness resources, and a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Salary Range

* $80,000 - $95,000

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
D2D Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $80,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary:**

A Project Manager at MediaNews Group is responsible for the flow of work through product development and acts as a servant leader and coach for an agile team. You will lead the team via agile practices, ensuring that the agreed-upon process is followed. You will also remove impediments and foster high-performing team dynamics, continuous flow, and constant improvement. In a larger project management context, you will be responsible for balancing the competing needs of scope, schedule, and cost, while uncovering and monitoring risks. Finally, the Project Manager keeps stakeholders apprised of the status of a project or ongoing product development and is highly visible throughout the organization.

We are looking for a confident leader who thrives in dynamic environments, embraces change, and enjoys solving complex problems. You will be running a scrum team and playing the role of project manager on a larger program as needed. The ideal candidate isn't afraid of deadlines, can assert themselves when necessary, and isn't shy about addressing tough issues when they arise. Everyone on our team is a hands-on contributor, so be ready to roll up your sleeves and make an impact.

***Although this is a remote role, candidates must reside in CO, FL, IL, MA, MN, OH, OK, PA, or TX.***

**What you will do:**

  

* Apply agile and occasional waterfall methodologies and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices to initiatives from idea to launch and beyond, while ensuring alignment with SDLC standards and company strategy
* Lead all aspects of the project, including planning, execution, timely delivery, functionality, quality, issue tracking, and communication
* Maintain accountability for project delivery to the PMO, business owner, and stakeholders
* Create initial project planning documentation, including assumptions/constraints, measures of success, quality measures, risks, mitigation plans, issues, dependencies, schedules, and change control strategy
* Report progress, risks, and issues to management and project stakeholders; track risks, risk mitigation, known issues, change requests, and change impact in writing, and work to resolve blockers to completion
* Use tracking tools to provide status and progress updates
* Contribute to quarterly planning, Scrum of Scrums, all other agile ceremonies, and the project management community of practice
* Lead by facilitation using standard scrum and scaled agile methodologies
* Enforce the priorities of the work to be performed, as determined with the product owner, business owner, and project stakeholders; obtain product manager and client sign-off on key project deliverables
* Conduct post-project reviews, lessons-learned discussions, and retrospectives
* Draft and create project archives and process improvement plans based on lessons learned and retrospectives; implement approved plans
* Add project documentation to the repository for use in future projects

**What you will bring:**

  

* Project management platform familiarity (Jira, Trello, Asana, etc.)
* Web technology platform knowledge preferred
* Experience in digital media strongly preferred
* Agile project management training and at least 2 years of experience
* Previous project management experience
* PMP or CSM certification preferred

**Benefits and Compensation:**

The salary range is $100,000 - $125,000. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to geographic location, education, work experience, time in role, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, the Company offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, life and disability insurance, 401k, as well as paid time off and select paid holidays (all benefits are based on eligibility). Please click the following link for more detailed information: www.mymedianewsgroup.com

**Who we are:**

MediaNews Group is a leading local news provider and digital marketing partner, with a 175+ year history dedicated to delivering impactful journalism and advertising that informs, inspires, and engages readers across diverse, local communities. With a portfolio of 77 daily and over 150 weekly publications nationwide, our products reach 47.2 million readers monthly with essential local news and information, including through brands such as: The Denver Post, San Jose's The Mercury News, Boston Herald, Saint Paul Pioneer Press, The Orange County Register, and more. The Product & Technology team's mission is to create people-centric digital technology that empower our local news and partners by putting people, product, and performance first. Our team builds product experiences across MediaNews Group's entire digital portfolio, including local news publications and the Adtaxi digital marketing agency. At MediaNews Group, you’ll join a team that values expertise, continuous learning, and autonomy, while embracing business agility through decentralized decision-making and scaled agile principles.

***“4x Built In Best Places to Work Winner - 2023-2026”***

  

**EEO Statement:**

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

**How To Apply:**

  

* Please submit an online application along with your resume for this position here

**Closing Date:**

  

* Continuous recruitment until the position is filled

**Conditions of Employment:**

  

* A full pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Must be willing to submit and pass the necessary required checks

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** REACH Project Manager

**Reports to:** Cancer Programs Director

**Salary Range:** $75,000 - $80,000 Annually DOQ

**Classification:** Full-time, Exempt

**Location:** Remote with occasional travel (approximately 15-20%)

**To Apply:** A résumé and a cover letter detailing your interest in the position and relevant experience are required. Applications submitted without will be automatically rejected.

**About AICAF**

The American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF), a national nonprofit, is committed to supporting American Indian and Alaska Native (Ai/AN) cancer patients, communities, tribal leaders, and healthcare providers with the knowledge and resources to improve cancer prevention, early detection, treatment, and survivorship outcomes across Indian Country. By educating and empowering, we can collectively work towards a cancer-free future for our people and future generations.

P**osition Summary**

The REACH Project Manager position involves active involvement in the Racial and Ethnic Approaches to Community Health (REACH) project, a nationwide initiative overseen by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). AICAF was one of fifty organizations to receive this funding aimed at improving health, preventing chronic diseases, and reducing health disparities among racial and ethnic populations with the highest risk, or burden, of chronic disease.

The REACH Project Manager will be responsible for oversight and implementation of the (REACH) project under the supervision of the Cancer Programs Manager. In this role, the AICAF team will lean into your expertise, which will include, but is not limited to: 1) coalition building and facilitation, community engagement, collaboration, and buy-in support with various entities, such as tribal, local, state, and national organizations; 2) the development and dissemination of culturally tailored materials and messaging; 3) knowledge of traditional tobacco practices; 4) the ability to implement activities and strategies to support positive outcomes; and 5) familiarity and capacity to understand and implement policy, systems, and environmental changes related to healthy eating, tobacco, well-being, and promotion of physical activity.

Please Note: while the primary focus of this role involves this ongoing REACH project, you may be asked to contribute to other tasks or projects, temporarily or permanently, as determined by organizational needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and report program activities; manage program budget; and participate in routine CDC meetings, annual performance reporting, and other required program reports to ensure compliance with funding and program requirements.
* Work with the leadership team on the implementation of organizational strategies, policies, and practices.
* Provide guidance and expertise as it relates to program implementation, policies, and coalition building through community collaboration and outreach.
* Provide program grant and contract oversight to effectively support and track employee workloads to successfully deliver program goals and deliverables according to work plans and timelines.
* Supervise and provide ongoing guidance, support, and performance oversight to a Project Coordinator, including workload prioritization, professional development, and alignment with program goals in a collaborative, consultative, and positive manner.
* Communicate program progress and potential issues via regular, timely updates.
* Maintain communications with clinic and community partners, consultants, and funders.
* Identify and pursue new projects and funding opportunities that fit within AICAF's strategic vision.
* Identify, develop, and support responses to relevant cancer issues related to the AICAF mission.
* Plan and disseminate findings to multiple audiences through reports, presentations, etc.
* Work effectively as an AICAF team member through participation across organization initiatives.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Education and Experience

* Master’s Degree in a health care field, such as public health, nursing, clinical health, or similar.
* At least 3 years of experience with public health programs and working with AI/AN health systems and/or communities.
* At least 3 years of experience in project management, including experience providing supervision to staff and managing workloads to meet program goals and deliverables.
* Experience in grant/contract management (planning, tracking, evaluation, and reporting).
* Solid understanding of evidence-based cancer prevention and control strategies.

General Skills and Abilities

* Must be highly organized and detail-oriented and be able to prioritize and carry out concurrent projects on deadlines, manage complex projects, and maintain self-direction (i.e. carry out all responsibilities of the job requirements with minimal day-to-day supervision).
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with demonstrated abilities in computer technology, report writing, facilitation, team collaboration, and public speaking.
* Sensitivity to cross-cultural differences and ability to work effectively within diverse contexts, demonstrating discretion, tact, knowledge, judgment, and overall ability in working effectively with diverse groups of people.
* Strategic thinker who is also willing to do hands-on work
* Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven workplace culture.
* Ability to navigate sensitive situations with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment.
* Experience with or willingness to learn Microsoft Office tools, including, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and SharePoint.
* Demonstrated high work ethic, integrity, and professional conduct.
* Strong passion for AICAF’s mission, vision, and values.

Other

* This position requires up to 15-20% travel, mostly to Minnesota and Oklahoma. Other work may be performed remotely.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike is seeking a passionate and strategic Sr. Competitive Intelligence Analyst III to support our Security for AI portfolio, including AI Detection and Response (AIDR), securing generative AI applications, and protecting autonomous agents. In this role, you will partner directly with Product, Sales, and cross-functional leaders to inform roadmap decisions, guide go-to-market strategy, and help CrowdStrike win in a rapidly evolving competitive landscape focused on securing the enterprise AI ecosystem against emerging threats like prompt injection and data leakage.

You will develop a deep, nuanced understanding of how competitors approach Security for AI, analyzing their ability to protect prompts, models, and agents, as well as the real reasons CrowdStrike wins or loses in the field. This work will scale globally and require tight partnership with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations, and other teams.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical proficiency in AI/ML for cybersecurity, practical insight into real-world security product development, and the ability to translate complex analysis into actionable guidance. This is a remote, individual-contributor role with significant visibility and impact.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Synthesize and formulate guidance on the strategic importance of Security for AI, emphasizing how the protection of autonomous agents and the mitigation of prompt-based threats create a significant competitive advantage.
* Provide a field-actionable, in-depth and ever-evolving understanding of the Security for AI market, analyzing competitors' ability to deliver accelerated detection and autonomous remediation across the full AI lifecycle.
* Provide tailored deal support (competitive surgeries & guidance), and develop a deep rapport with the field.
* Work closely with the rest of the Competitive Intelligence team and technical stakeholders to serve as the primary liaison for Security for AI competition.
* Make recommendations on sales tactics and product strategy to enable CrowdStrike to win in the market.
* Be a self-starter with an ownership mentality. You will work autonomously in the development of project plans, requirements, timelines, content, and ongoing tracking/updates of the Security for AI competitive landscape.
* Conduct win/loss analysis, using both quantitative and qualitative data sources to determine why CrowdStrike wins and loses vs. the competition.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field (Computer Science, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related discipline).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the cybersecurity market with a primary focus on Security for AI/ML, including demonstrated understanding of AI/LLM attack surfaces (e.g., prompt injection, model poisoning, training data leakage) and AI governance.
* Deep familiarity with the Security for AI competitive landscape, including major industry players, AI safety frameworks, and the evolving regulatory environment.
* Minimum of 5 years relevant work experience (Ideal candidates will have experience in at least TWO of the following): sales engineer/pre-sales, competitive intelligence, solution architect, product management, technical marketing, and product marketing
* Proven ability to synthesize complex technical concepts related to AI threats and security into field-actionable guidance and executive summaries.
* Superior communication skills including experience presenting to senior & executive level management.
* Excellent people and project management skills to manage initiatives and build rapport with cross-functional teams and third parties.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Relevant certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, or specialized cybersecurity fields.
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI in a security context.
* Direct experience with customers (as a customer, or in a customer support or field role) selling or supporting security products.

It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote Data Analyst will serve as an embedded analytics partner and subject matter expert to operational leaders across the organization. This role is responsible for transforming complex operational and performance data into actionable insights, dashboards, and recommendations that support business decisions, operational efficiency, and strategic initiatives. The analyst will work across multiple data domains and systems, identifying trends, diagnosing process breakdowns, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement and measure improvements. jobs.title: Business & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Five Sigma is an AI-native InsurTech company transforming the insurance claims management industry. Our cloud-based Claims Management Platform enables insurance carriers and organizations to streamline operations, automate workflows, and make smarter, data-driven decisions.

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Business & Data Analyst** to join our Global Delivery team.

You will work directly with US-based insurance customers to translate complex business requirements and data into functional solutions within Five Sigma's Claims Management Platform.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role combining business analysis, data investigation, functional solution design, and validation throughout the implementation lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Functional Design**

* Lead discovery sessions with insurance customers to understand their claims operations, workflows, business rules, and challenges.
* Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify edge cases, business exceptions, and gaps in customer requirements.
* Map business requirements to Five Sigma's platform capabilities and define appropriate configurations.
* Partner with Delivery Managers and technical implementation teams to evaluate solution approaches.

**Data Analysis & Integration**

* Analyze customer data structures, quality, and business meaning.
* Own source-to-target data mappings, transformation rules, and reconciliation criteria.
* Support data migrations, integrations, and reporting requirements.
* Use SQL to investigate datasets, identify inconsistencies, and validate results.
* Ensure data accuracy and alignment with customer business processes.

**Testing & Validation**

* Define business test scenarios and expected outcomes.
* Validate configurations, workflows, calculations, reports, and migrated data.
* Support UAT and troubleshoot functional and data-related issues.
* Ensure the delivered solution meets agreed business requirements.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with customers, Delivery Managers, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Maintain clear documentation of requirements, mappings, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate complex findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Remain actively involved from discovery through go-live.

  
Requirements:
  

* 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Business & Data Analyst in a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
* Experience in US Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance, claims management, or insurance technology.
* Familiarity with claims workflows, policy administration, and insurance data.
* Experience with enterprise software implementations, data migration, and system integrations.
* Proven ability to translate complex business processes into functional requirements and specifications.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote, global environment.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with APIs, JSON, ETL processes, and data reconciliation.
* Experience implementing configurable enterprise SaaS platforms.

### **Why Five Sigma?**

Join a fast-growing global InsurTech company where your work directly impacts how insurance organizations operate. You'll collaborate with talented professionals, solve meaningful business challenges, and help shape the future of AI-powered claims management.

**Join us and help transform the insurance industry.**

jobs.title: Healthcare Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Healthcare Data Analyst**

*Analytics Team*

**Position Summary**

The Healthcare Data Analyst supports recurring healthcare utilization, quality, access, financial, and operational analysis in partnership with senior analysts and cross-functional stakeholders. This role analyzes and interprets healthcare data and reporting related to claims, eligibility, encounters, service utilization, care patterns, population trends, and client or payer performance. Using Power BI, established reporting processes, and appropriate data-validation methods, the analyst identifies meaningful trends and drivers, evaluates performance, and communicates accurate, timely insights that inform operational planning, program evaluation, and healthcare decision-making.

**Responsibilities**

· Analyze recurring healthcare reports—including claims, eligibility, encounters, service utilization, access, volume, quality, and trend summaries—to identify meaningful patterns, variances, and emerging issues; validate results using established quality-control processes and communicate decision-ready insights.

· Utilize Power BI dashboards and recurring reporting packages that track key utilization, access, quality, operational, population, and client performance metrics.

· Root-cause analysis of changes in utilization patterns, service trends, member or patient activity, access indicators, population characteristics, and payer or client performance to identify meaningful changes and opportunities.

· Fulfill well-scoped ad hoc analysis requests by extracting defined data sets, applying approved logic, and summarizing findings in a clear, organized, and decision-ready format.

· Validate the consistency of claims, eligibility, encounter, utilization, quality, and operational results across internal systems, client files, payer reports, and dashboard outputs; investigate material discrepancies and document their impact on reported findings.

· Partner with Clinical, Operations, Data Management, Population Health, Client Services, and other stakeholders to provide accurate, timely analytical support; perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

· 2–3 years of experience in healthcare data analysis, population health, managed care, health plan, provider, or related analytics.

· Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, health informatics, data analytics, statistics, or a related field required.

· Proficiency in Excel required, including formulas, logical functions, lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.

· Power BI user-level experience strongly preferred, including building new queries, calculated fields, and report development.

· Ability to evaluate healthcare data for accuracy, identify outliers or inconsistencies, follow defined quality-control procedures, and ask thoughtful questions when results do not align with expectations.

· Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage recurring reporting and analytical deadlines.

· Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain healthcare data, trends, methods, and issues to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Working knowledge of healthcare claims, eligibility, encounters, utilization, quality measures, or managed care concepts, with an eagerness to deepen expertise in healthcare analytics.

**Requirements**

· Residence within the Continental United States

· Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

**Business Analyst (Contract)**

**Summary:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven Operations Coordinator to serve as the front door for a high-volume infrastructure capacity request workflow. In this fully remote role, you will manage an incoming queue of capacity requests, validate data accuracy, route cases to the appropriate owners, and resolve routine requests using established procedures. By keeping the queue organized and well-documented, you will free up senior capacity leads to focus on complex prioritization and customer-facing work. This is a staff augmentation role supporting an existing team, and all capacity allocation, exception approvals, and policy decisions remain with full-time staff.

* Send clear, professional follow-up communications to account teams when information is missing or clarification is needed

* Prepare the case queue ahead of scrum meetings and capture notes and action items during sessions
* Produce weekly reports covering case volumes, backlog aging, and escalation summaries

* 2+ years of advanced Microsoft Excel usage including lookups, pivot tables, and data reconciliation in an operational context
* 1+ year of exposure to Microsoft Azure concepts such as compute resources, VM families, SKUs, and regional infrastructure; AZ-900 certification is a plus
* Background in cloud operations, IT service management, or supply chain operations is strongly preferred

* Associate or bachelor's degree in business management, economics, finance, accounting, or a related field preferred
* AZ-900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals certification is a plus

* Case and queue management: triage, prioritization, and routing within a ticketing or case management system

* Analytical and critical thinking: pattern recognition and the ability to work independently within defined boundaries
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure fundamentals including compute, VM families and SKUs, and regions

As an Information Security Analyst II for the Federal Programs team, you will support efforts to respond to U.S. Government regulations and standards, including FedRAMP Rev. 5, FedRAMP 20x, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG), and applicable Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) , as applicable. You will provide subject matter expertise for the design, implementation, operations, management, and maintenance of the Datadog product in all aspects of Information Assurance and Information Security as it relates to Datadog's Federal Programs activities. This includes being able to assess and mitigate system security threats and risks, validate system security requirements, analyze and collaborate on system security designs, verify compliance with system security requirements, manage the complete internal and external assessment and audit lifecycle, testing, and act as a liaison with other departments and business units to support ongoing system security operations and maintenance. You will evaluate the suitability of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-backed products for Federal regulated industry customers and you will leverage AI to build automations which will allow Datadog to demonstrate compliance with current and future requirements.

  

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

  

**What You'll Do:** (Describe role responsibilities here)

* Support security efforts in pursuit of U.S. Government certifications and accreditations (FedRAMP, GovRAMP, Cloud Computing SRG).
* Document Datadog practices to provide transparency to customers, prospects and other stakeholders.
* Communicate directly with Datadog customers, prospects and other stakeholders.
* Work across security and engineering teams to design, implement, and monitor security and compliance features.
* Support assessment and continuous monitoring and reporting activities.
* Engage with external stakeholders (auditors, regulators, customers) to clearly explain Datadog's compliance posture
* Design and maintain defensive policies that allow the Datadog security and general engineering teams to move quickly and adapt to an evolving threat landscape.

* Use modern tooling to increase the capabilities and efficiency of existing compliance programs.

  

**Who You Are:** (Describe role qualifications here)

* You have a BS and a minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience
* You have a proven track record working in security policy, compliance, information security operations or security consulting
* You have a strong understanding of cloud services architecture (Amazon Web Services)
* You have demonstrable experience designing, supporting, advising, and assessing the implementation of security controls for a FedRAMP certified and/or DoD Impact Levels ⅘ authorized system.

* You have or are able to acquire a certification in compliance with applicable Government requirements
* Eligibility to obtain US Government Security Clearance in the future, or current active adjudicated Public Trust Background Investigation, is a plus

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**TL;DR** **TL;DR** Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.
  
  
Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

  

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

  

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

  

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Update existing research while monitoring developments on sanctions issues, regulatory environments, and other national security or compliance-related matters.
* Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
* Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
* Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
* Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
* At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
* Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
* High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

### **BENEFITS:**

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

* Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
* FSA program for both medical and dependent care
* 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
* Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $65,000-$75,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com to apply.

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

**Compensation:** $65,000 - $75,000 / year

**Manager, Performance Improvement and Outcomes**
=================================================

The Manager, Performance Improvement and Outcomes leads hospital-wide initiatives that advance clinical outcomes, patient safety, regulatory readiness, and organizational performance. Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Quality and Patient Safety, this role integrates data analytics, structured improvement methodologies, project management, and cross-functional leadership to identify performance gaps, implement evidence-based interventions, and achieve measurable, sustainable results. The Manager supports strategic quality and benchmarking initiatives, including CMS Star Ratings, Leapfrog Hospital Safety Grade and Hospital Survey, Vizient, U.S. News & World Report, and other external quality programs, while promoting accountability, continuous improvement, and alignment with hospital and health system priorities.

Key responsibilities may include:

* Leading multidisciplinary performance improvement initiatives aligned with hospital and health system strategic priorities, clinical outcomes, patient safety, regulatory readiness, and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborating with physicians, nursing leaders, clinical and operational stakeholders, and department leaders to identify improvement opportunities, establish measurable performance targets, and implement evidence-based interventions.
* Applying structured performance improvement methodologies, including Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA), Lean, process mapping, root cause analysis, and other quality improvement techniques to address performance gaps and improve outcomes.
* Developing and maintaining project charters that define project scope, objectives, milestones, accountable owners, timelines, deliverables, and success measures.
* Evaluating the effectiveness of improvement interventions by monitoring process performance, clinical outcomes, and operational results, and incorporating successful practices into standard workflows.
* Establishing monitoring, accountability, and sustainability plans to maintain improvements and prevent regression after project implementation.
* Analyzing clinical, quality, patient safety, and operational data to identify performance trends, variation, contributing factors, and opportunities for improvement.
* Developing and maintaining dashboards, scorecards, tracking tools, and performance reports that communicate baseline performance, targets, trends, milestones, and progress toward established goals.
* Collaborating with data analysts, clinical informatics, Finance, and department leaders to validate data sources, measure definitions, reporting methodologies, and data accuracy.
* Translating complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations, presentations, and performance updates for executive leadership, committees, clinical teams, and other organizational stakeholders.
* Distinguishing process improvement measures from changes in patient outcomes and monitoring both to evaluate intervention effectiveness and demonstrate meaningful results.
* Ensuring performance reports, dashboards, and supporting documentation are accurate, timely, and consistent with organizational reporting standards.
* Coordinating improvement activities supporting CMS quality programs, Leapfrog Hospital Safety Grade and Hospital Survey, Vizient, U.S. News & World Report, and other external quality and benchmarking initiatives.
* Monitoring external quality measure specifications, reporting deadlines, methodology changes, and program requirements in collaboration with designated subject matter experts and data owners.
* Identifying drivers of performance gaps in external quality measures and coordinating targeted action plans to improve hospital performance and benchmarking results.
* Supporting accurate and timely external submissions through data validation, documentation review, evidence collection, and coordination with responsible departments and data owners.
* Communicating the impact of clinical and operational performance on public reporting, organizational reputation, patient outcomes, quality ratings, and financial performance.
* Maintaining a consolidated roadmap that connects external quality program priorities with internal hospital performance improvement initiatives, strategic goals, and measurable deliverables.
* Managing a centralized portfolio of priority improvement projects, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, expected outcomes, and overall project status.
* Leading project meetings, documenting decisions, tracking action items, monitoring deadlines, and maintaining accountability among project owners and participating departments.
* Identifying implementation barriers, addressing delays, coordinating solutions, and escalating issues requiring leadership decisions or additional organizational support.
* Providing concise, timely updates to leadership and stakeholders regarding project progress, risks, resource needs, outstanding decisions, barriers, and achieved results.
* Coordinating competing improvement priorities and optimizing staff time

jobs.title: Program Manager, Partnerships
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

#### **The Role**

The Partnerships department operates in a fast-paced environment with a lean team. Key priorities arise from major events like SKO or Forge Partner Day, cross-functional initiatives, and urgent executive inquiries. Top-tier partnership teams require a dedicated program manager to own these priorities, drive execution, and maintain clear visibility into project status, blockers, and ownership.

Operating across the entire department rather than within a single partner segment, this role collaborates across every functional pillar. Key responsibilities centre on establishing clear workstream visibility and managing high-priority ad-hoc projects. This includes maintaining an accurate single source of truth for ongoing department initiatives, supporting program management for flagship events such as SKO, Forge Partner Day, and the departmental kick-off, and partnering closely with the AVP, Partner Experience to maintain the departmental operating rhythm—encompassing OKRs, business reviews, strategic narratives, All Hands meetings, and internal communications.

Rapid growth has outpaced formal tracking, leaving initiatives reliant on informal ownership and tracking. We need a program manager to establish structure, seamlessly manage diverse workstreams, and build lasting, repeatable processes. Success is defined by delivering high-quality projects on time and maintaining clear, transparent visibility into overall department status.

#### **What You'll Own**

* **Workstream visibility.** Maintain one view of cross-departmental initiatives: owners, status, dependencies and risks, with Jira as the source of truth. Run regular check-ins that keep it honest, raise concerns before they become surprises, and give leadership a clear picture of what is moving and what is not.
* **Ad-hoc and flagship projects.** Take projects from brief to delivery: agree scope and owners, build the plan, chase the dependencies, manage the timeline and run the follow-up.
* **Company moments such as SKO and Forge Partner Day.** Support the Partnerships contribution to events where the department is on stage. This may include working with leadership on the narrative and theme, briefing speakers, gathering content from pillar leads and coordinating with Marketing and Events.
* **Cross-functional initiatives.** Drive initiatives that cut across teams and need a single owner for delivery, such as moving a process from one team to another or launching a change that touches several pillars. Clarify who does what, keep the work moving and close it out properly.
* **Operating rhythm.** Support the department's OKRs, monthly and quarterly business reviews, quarterly narratives and monthly All Hands. Build the trackers and templates, chase inputs, prepare pre-reads and help run the sessions, so that leaders spend their time on decisions.
* **Communications and PR-FAQs.** Support the cadence of department updates and the PR-FAQ tracker for major launches, so that format, tone and timing stay consistent and status is honest.
* **Planning and engagement.** Support the SVP, Partnerships and Partner Operations team with annual planning, and the follow-up from the employee engagement survey in Culture Amp: tracking actions through to completion and reporting back on what changed.
* **Salesforce alignment.** If the acquisition of Braze by Salesforce completes, help plan and track the work to bring the Braze partner program in line with the broader Salesforce partner program and ecosystem, and keep it visible alongside everything else in flight.

#### **What This Role Is Really About**

A department our size can't hire a specialist for every function, and shouldn't. What it needs is someone who can pick up whatever matters most this month, run it properly and leave something behind that works without them. One month that is the narrative and run of show for Forge Partner Day. The next it is an initiative that three teams each assume another team owns. The through-line is visibility: whatever you are working on, people can see where it stands.

You will not own the content or the decisions. Pillar leads own their numbers and their stories, and leadership owns the choices. You own the delivery and the clarity around it. That means asking the question that exposes a gap in a plan, noticing when a deadline will slip a week before it does, and telling a leader that their narrative buries the lead. You do this without formal authority, and you earn trust by making everyone else's job easier.

You will also see things that are sensitive: survey results, plans in progress, changes to the organisation. Discretion is part of the job.

* **Drives ownership to completion.** You step in to claim unassigned initiatives, assign clear accountability, and steer them through to successful execution.
* **Communicates with clarity and impact.** You distill complex upda

jobs.description:
### **Description**

**TL;DR** **TL;DR** Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.  
  
Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Update existing research while monitoring developments on sanctions issues, regulatory environments, and other national security or compliance-related matters.
* Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
* Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
* Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

  

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
* Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
* At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
* Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
* High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

  

### **BENEFITS:**

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

* Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
* FSA program for both medical and dependent care
* 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
* Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $65,000-$75,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com to apply.

jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton's Physical Security team is responsible for the safety and security of all Peraton facilities across the enterprise. The team delivers this mission through electronic access control systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV) and video management systems, intrusion detection, contracted guard services, visitor management, and ongoing physical security assessments. The team also plays a central role in Peraton's growth activities, forecasting physical security costs associated with new facility buildouts, program captures, and proposal efforts.

We are seeking a Physical Security Analyst to join the team as a junior-level individual contributor. This is a developmental role designed for someone with foundational experience in physical security, facilities, or a related security field who is looking to grow into a well-rounded physical security professional. The analyst will support the team's day-to-day operations as well as its proposal and growth activities, working alongside senior team members on real-world projects from day one.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Physical Security Operations Support**
----------------------------------------

* Support day-to-day administration of enterprise physical security systems, including access control, CCTV/video management, visitor management, and intrusion detection
* Assist with badge issuance, access provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine access reviews
* Monitor and triage physical security alarms and events; escalate as appropriate
* Support investigations into facility-related security incidents and compile supporting documentation
* Help maintain accurate inventories of physical security equipment, cameras, readers, and related assets

**Contracted Guard Force Support**
----------------------------------

* Help coordinate day-to-day interactions with contracted guard service providers
* Review guard post orders, patrol logs, and incident reports for completeness
* Assist with guard scheduling coordination and documentation of post requirements
* Support site visits and quality checks of guard operations

**Proposal and Growth Support (Pricing & Cost Forecasting)**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Support proposal and capture teams by developing physical security cost estimates for new facility buildouts and program expansions
* Research vendor pricing for access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and related physical security equipment
* Help maintain reusable pricing templates, standardized bills of materials, and historical cost data
* Compile physical security sections of proposal narratives under the direction of senior team members
* Participate in site surveys of candidate facilities and document findings

**Documentation & Reporting**
-----------------------------

* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), site-specific security plans, and system documentation
* Prepare periodic reports on access control activity, incidents, and system health
* Support audits, physical security assessments, and compliance reviews
* Maintain organized project files and documentation for proposal and buildout efforts

**Collaboration**
-----------------

* Partner with Facilities, IT, Program Security, and HR teams on cross-functional efforts
* Interact professionally with employees, contractors, and visitors regarding physical security matters
* Participate in team meetings, project reviews, and ongoing training

##### **Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Homeland Security, Security Management, Business, or a related field —
* At least 1 year of experience in physical security, facility security, law enforcement, military security operations, or a closely related role

With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

  

**Axle** is seeking a ***Data Analyst*** to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the **Bethesda, MD.**

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

  + Healthcare (FSA)

**Position Overview**

The Data Analyst will conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to evaluate program effectiveness, improve administrative operations, and support informed management decisions. The role includes developing study methods, reviewing financial and program data, conducting cost analyses, preparing reports, and recommending improvements to workflows and management processes.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop study methods and evaluation techniques for program reviews, studies, and audits; interpret findings and recommend improvements.
* Gather, reconcile, validate, and analyze quantitative and qualitative information from multiple sources, including incomplete or conflicting data.
* Evaluate programs, grant operations, and administrative activities against established goals, measures, and objectives.

* Review financial, narrative, and statistical reports and program data submitted at local, state, regional, and federal levels to identify significant findings and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct project life-cycle cost analyses, cost-benefit analyses, and economic evaluations of programs.
* Evaluate internal processes, procedures, organizational structures, and data systems and recommend changes that improve efficiency, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
* Develop or modify work methods, records and filing systems, management processes, staffing patterns, operational guidelines, and procedures for administering program services.
* Assess opportunities to automate administrative workflows and adopt appropriate technology developments.
* Evaluate and recommend organizational changes, including options for centralizing or decentralizing operations.

* Participate in meetings and conferences with administrative, scientific, technical, and interagency stakeholders to gather information, present conclusions, resolve problems, and develop alternative courses of action.
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned program analyses, planning activities, and science policy requests.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information management, computer science, data analytics/artificial intelligence, or equivalent.

* Knowledge of data analysis techniques and analytical and evaluative methods for assessing program and administrative effectiveness.
* Ability to plan, schedule, and conduct projects and studies and adapt evaluation criteria to assess and improve organizational productivity.
* Knowledge of laws, regulations, policies, and precedents affecting program resources and administrative support operations.
* Knowledge of program goals, objectives, work processes, and administrative operations relevant to the work being analyzed.

jobs.title: Finance Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
This entry‑level role supports the Senior Manager, Finance Operations in procurement controls, compliance administration, procure‑to‑pay workflows, audit preparation, documentation maintenance, project‑code accuracy, and operational reporting support. The analyst ensures procurement evidence is complete, systems are updated, documentation is organized, and month‑end/quarter‑end P2P tasks are executed cleanly. Taken together, this role strengthens the company's internal controls, audit readiness, procurement accuracy, and overall operational reliability.

**Your main responsibilities will be:**

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Assist with review of monthly revenue report support materials, contract waterfalls, metrics reviews, and accuracy checks.
* Help maintain SharePoint repositories: cleanup, document migration, folder organization, audit storage.
* Draft and review SOPs, workflows, process maps, and control narratives for internal finance operations.

**Procurement Controls & SOX Compliance Administration**

* Maintain procurement SOX evidence including POs, packing slips, receiving documentation, invoice approvals, and vendor support.
* Validate end‑to‑end procure‑to‑pay documentation for control testing (PO receiving invoice).
* Support procurement SOX testing: approval routing, segregation of duties, completeness of receiving.
* Track recurring procurement issues and support remediation with leadership.

**Procure‑to‑Pay Operational Support**

* Review purchase requisitions prior to PO creation to ensure financial accuracy, proper coding, compliance with approval thresholds, and alignment with SOX procurement controls.
* Perform a secondary review of Purchase Orders before they are sent to vendors, validating correct project codes, amounts, supporting documentation, and approval routing to ensure compliance and reduce downstream corrections.
* Review open‑PO and receiving reports and confirm accuracy of identified discrepancies, missing receipts, or delayed approvals for month‑end and quarter‑end close.
* Validate procurement trackers maintained by the analyst, including open POs, RMAs, packing slip issues, and approval status, and ensure that identified issues are properly escalated and documented for audit readiness.
* Review and QA procurement‑related data during Costpoint, Concur and Jira updates to confirm that the analyst's work aligns with SOX requirements, audit expectations, and financial reporting needs.

**Audit & PCAOB Support**

* Review and confirm documentation related to revenue schedules, project‑code setup, backlog support, and customer‑acceptance evidence.
* Assist in maintaining audit folders, respond to follow‑ups, and assist with contract‑level tie‑outs.
* Ensure accuracy of data stored in Costpoint and SharePoint for audit retrieval.

**Project Code & Operational Data Maintenance**

* Review new project‑code requests, validate fields, prepare cleanup lists, and ensure downstream reporting accuracy.
* Support administrative updates for project codes impacting procurement routing, revenue tracking, or reporting workflows.
* Coordinate with PMs, Operations, A/P, Engineering, IT and other departments to resolve missing documentation and confirm system accuracy.

**Consultant Coordination**

* Prepare materials for accounting, SOX, and system consultants; track open issues and follow‑up items.
* Organize documentation for external reviews and system assessments.

**Your skills and qualifications:**  
**Essential education and experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business (or equivalent experience).  
  Strong attention to detail and comfort verifying documentation.
* Basic Excel skills; willingness to learn procurement modules in Costpoint and Concur.
* Interest in operational finance, procurement workflows, and compliance.
* Highly organized and methodical.
* Comfortable investigating mismatches (e.g., invoice versus PO versus packing slip).
* Communicates clearly and follows up reliably.
* Eager to learn how procurement controls support SOX compliance.

**Company Overview:**

HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.

*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*
