Business Operations Manager – Dental Group

**Location:** South East London  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** £45,000 per year depending on experience, with performance-related bonus potential

About Us

We are a growing, privately focused dental group with two practices in South East London: Belmont Park Dental Care and Eltham Dental.

The business is entering an exciting stage of growth, with a focus on high-quality private dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, hygiene growth, patient experience and operational excellence.

Across the group, we have built a strong reputation for patient care, with over **700 five-star reviews**. We are committed to quality, growth and creating an excellent experience for both patients and team members.

We are looking for a commercially minded, organised and proactive **Business Operations Manager** to work closely with the owner and help lead the next stage of growth across both practices.

This is not just a standard practice manager role. We are looking for someone who can take ideas, create systems, manage people, track performance and help drive the business forward.

The Role

The Business Operations Manager will oversee the day-to-day running and performance of both practices, ensuring the teams, diaries, patient journey and business systems are working effectively.

You will work directly with the owner to implement strategy, improve operations, support the team and help grow private revenue.

You do not necessarily need to come from a dental background. Experience in private healthcare, aesthetics, hospitality, retail, customer service, operations or an owner-led growing business would also be highly relevant.

Key ResponsibilitiesOperations

* Oversee the smooth running of both dental practices
* Ensure rotas, holiday cover, nurse cover and reception cover are well managed
* Improve diary utilisation and reduce empty chair time
* Ensure systems and processes are followed consistently
* Identify operational problems and create practical solutions
* Support the implementation of new projects and practice improvements
* Take initiative in spotting areas for improvement and helping to move the business forward

Team Management

* Support and manage practice coordinators, reception, nurses and treatment coordinators
* Help build a positive, accountable and high-performing team culture
* Hold regular team meetings and performance check-ins
* Deal with day-to-day staff issues professionally and fairly
* Help improve communication between clinicians, nurses, reception and management
* Encourage a positive, can-do attitude across the team

Business Growth

* Work with the owner to implement growth ideas across both practices
* Help drive private treatment revenue, including implants, Invisalign, hygiene and cosmetic dentistry
* Monitor new patient enquiries and lead follow-up
* Improve treatment-plan tracking and patient conversion
* Support marketing campaigns by ensuring the team follows up enquiries properly
* Help improve the overall patient journey and customer experience

Performance Tracking

You will be responsible for helping track and improve key business numbers, including:

* Practice revenue
* Private revenue
* Dentist diary utilisation
* Hygienist diary utilisation
* NHS UDA performance
* New patient enquiries
* Implant and Invisalign enquiries
* Treatment plans sent and accepted
* Missed calls and response times
* Google reviews
* Staff sickness and holiday cover
* Patient complaints and feedback

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Commercially minded
* Highly organised
* Confident managing people
* Good with numbers and performance tracking
* Calm under pressure
* Proactive and solution-focused
* Able to turn ideas into clear actions
* Comfortable holding people accountable
* Strong with systems and follow-up
* Warm and professional with patients and staff
* Positive, enthusiastic and willing to get stuck in
* Able to use initiative rather than waiting to be told every step
* Keen to grow personally and professionally as the business grows
* Able to work closely with an owner-led business

Experience Required

* Previous experience in operations, management, healthcare, hospitality, retail or a service-based business
* Experience managing a team
* Strong organisational and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Good understanding of KPIs, targets and performance management
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, systems and reports

What We Are Looking For

This role would suit someone who wants to grow with the business and become a key person within the organisation.

We are looking for someone with a positive mindset, a can-do attitude and the ability to take ownership. The right person will be hands-on, practical, commercially aware and confident enough to use their initiative.

We are looking for someone who can become the bridge between the owner’s vision and the team’s day-to-day execution.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary
* Performance-related bonus potential
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding dental group
* Varied and interesting role across two practices
* Direct involvement in business growth and strategy
* Supportive owner-led environment
* Opportunity to make a real impact
* A business committed to quality, growth and excellent patient care

Schedule

* Monday to Friday
* Full-time
* Occasional flexibility may be required depending on business needs

Application Question

Please include a short cover note explaining why you feel you would be suitable for this role, especially if you are applying from outside dentistry.

How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a brief covering message.

Pay: £45,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Title: Business Operations Manager**

**Location:** Office-based (Haslemere, Surrey)  
**Company:** BoomSpace  
**Type:** Full-time

**About BoomSpace**

BoomSpace is a specialist AV and workplace technology company providing consultancy, design, integration, project delivery and ongoing support. Our small, agile team works closely with clients and delivery partners to create reliable, well-engineered technology environments.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, highly organised Business Operations Manager to own day-to-day operations across the business. This hands-on management role requires forward planning, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Projects and Service are key priorities, alongside procurement, logistics, resource planning, business support and compliance. The remit includes social media coordination, but not broader marketing strategy or delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Core Business Operations**

· Coordinate operations across the business, connecting priorities, people and deadlines.

· Track actions and dependencies, escalate risks and improve operational workflows and reporting.

**Projects, Service and Resource Planning**

· Support project delivery and Service, coordinating actions, schedules, preventative maintenance and resources.

· Maintain accurate project records, checking quotations, purchase orders, RAMS and delivery requirements.

· Liaise with colleagues, clients, suppliers and subcontractors; resolve scheduling clashes and flag decisions needed.

· Coordinate site access, travel, accommodation and itineraries, keeping calendars and booking information current.

**Procurement, Logistics and Supplier Coordination**

· Manage purchasing, orders and lead times; align deliveries, equipment movement and storage with schedules.

· Build supplier relationships, support reviews and forward planning, and flag delivery or cost issues.

**Business Support, Governance and Compliance**

· Support accounts, expenses, billing and enquiries; maintain office, vehicle and supplier contract renewals.

· Coordinate health and safety administration, policies, risk assessments and staff training records.

· Maintain subcontractor compliance records, including right-to-work and certification checks; escalate gaps before work is scheduled or authorised.

**Social Media**

· Coordinate approved social media content, scheduling and publication around operational priorities.

· Oversee the Social Media Marketing Assistant and agreed external support, maintaining brand consistency and basic performance updates.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Experience in business operations, project coordination, service support or a comparable role, ideally in a small or fast-moving business.

· Strong organisation and prioritisation, with a proactive approach, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

· Clear communication and the confidence to work independently, collaborate across teams and coordinate others.

· Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Planner and Xero; social media tools are useful.

· Flexibility to work outside standard hours when business needs require.

· An interest in AV and workplace technology is welcome but not essential.

Pay: £40,000.00-£45,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* Health & wellbeing programme
* On-site parking
* Transport links

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Haslemere, Surrey: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you have experience organising workloads, coordinating activities or supporting day-to-day business operations?
* Is the advertised salary of £40,000–£45,000 in line with your expectations?
* What is your notice period or earliest available start date?

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (required)

Work Location: In person

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Program Manager to join our EU AMZL Launch and Expansion team, focusing on retrofits projects across France, Italy, Spain, Germany and UK. This role is crucial in driving our infrastructure projects and network strategy to enhance operational efficiency, improve customer experience, and support sustainable growth in the region.  
  
Projects will include partnering with Engineering, Finance, Design and Construction, and other stakeholders to help optimize the existing network of Amazon Logistics nodes in the EU to facilitate the organization’s growth plans, and other cross functional Supply Chain, Transportation, Engineering & Infrastructure initiatives.  
  
The role is for 12 months on a Fixed Term Contract basis.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and manage a portfolio of maintenance and infrastructure projects across an assigned region and ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards
* Plan and oversee upgrades to existing sites, including office spaces, optimization of the shop floor, and building infrastructure to facilitate AMZL's Last Mile delivery fleet operation
* Collaborate with operations teams to set and raise performance standards at site level
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including operations, finance, real estate, design and construction and engineering, to ensure project success
* Develop comprehensive business cases and strategy documents with a goal to seek senior leadership approval, including director level executives

You will be a natural self-starter who is comfortable leading complex, cross functional programs. To be successful in this role, you will have a true hands-on approach, will demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and will be an effective communicator up to the senior management level. The successful candidate will continuously show a think big attitude and will look beyond their direct scope of responsibility.

At AMZL EU Launch & Expansion, our core purpose is to design, develop, and optimize Amazon's Last Mile delivery network across Europe. We drive strategic growth through innovative infrastructure solutions and data-driven capacity planning, ensuring we meet current demands while building for the future. By combining operational excellence with sustainable practices, we create a robust and efficient delivery network that serves all business lines and delivery types. Our commitment to safety, standardization, and continuous improvement enables us to transform the European logistics landscape while maintaining Amazon's position as the most customer-centric logistics provider.

* Experience defining and executing program requirements

* Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience leading process improvements
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

#### **About the role**

The Business Analyst is responsible for ensuring that new technology and processes meet the needs of the business and its people through creating fit-for-purpose solutions which integrate seamlessly with existing technology and processes. You’ll help drive consensus between a wide range of business stakeholders to underpin the delivery of organisational objectives.

In this role, you will focus on the opportunity to order technology, processes, compliance, and operations, as well as operational excellence and scalability within the projects assigned.

As a Business Analyst, you’ll perform data analysis and conduct a consistent review of data metrics to guide decision-making and enhancements to support scalability and efficiencies.

#### **What you’ll do**

* Analyse processes and technology tools as they are (as-is), compare them to the future and improved designs (to-be) and determine the necessary changes for arriving at the improved state.
* Document process information using visual diagrams in the form of business process models (using the Business Process Management Notation or the Flowchart Notation).
* Design business processes (to-be) and manage any subsequent changes to them.
* Examine processes holistically to understand the impact of changing them on people, strategy, systems and general business operations.
* Coordinate business processes signoffs on behalf of the accountable project manager.
* Together with the test manager design a test plan based on business processes and scenarios, Undertake hands on testing when appropriate.
* Work with the Training Team to identify any specific training points and/or validate training materials.

* Maintain documentation regarding various projects, processes and operations.
* Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams.

* Strong skills in Process Mapping and Business Process Reengineering.
* Experience of Robotic Process Automation is advantageous.
* Excellent command of English (essential) and Spanish (preferable).
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Experience facilitating workshops and focus groups.
* Strong business/client engagement skills.
* Experience developing business requirements.
* Experience developing instructional and procedural documentation and presentations.
* High level of competence with MS Office and MS Visio.
* Ability to communicate at all levels.
* Strong planning and organisational skills.
* Strong Team player.
* Demonstrates resilience and comfortable with ambiguity.
* Customer oriented.
* Passionate for continuous improvement.
* Ability to make constructive challenge.
* Ability to identify key issues and enact a mitigation plan.
* Ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders to support proposed strategies, process improvements and operational decisions.
* Resourcefulness and ability to devise creative solutions to problems.

Skills and Experience:

* Minimum 2 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
* Supplier and stakeholder management.
* Demonstrable understanding of technology-driven change management.
* Desktop packages including Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Clear understanding of risk and issue management processes.
* Knowledge of project management tools and techniques.
* Robotic Process Automation (specifically UiPath technologies).

Description:

**Making the world** **Move**

  

Exolum are an innovative fuel storage company with the priority of a green energy future operating globally. People are at the heart our expansion plans with a focus on developing our colleagues to reach their potential while accepting everyone as they are!

  

**Project Manager- Flexible site location- Permanent**

  

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Asset Technology team. Reporting to the Pipeline Systems Project Portfolio Manager, you will be responsible for the safe, compliant and effective delivery of engineering projects across Exolum's investment programme. You will manage projects through the full lifecycle, from concept development and business case preparation through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and closeout.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, contractors and suppliers, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with regulatory requirements and Exolum governance standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Capital Project Delivery

* Deliver engineering investment projects from concept through to asset handover in accordance with Exolum's Capital Project Delivery Process.
* Develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules and business cases to support investment decisions.
* Manage multidisciplinary engineering, procurement and construction activities.
* Ensure completed assets are safely integrated into operations and transferred to the asset owner with all supporting documentation.
* Support annual investment planning and portfolio prioritisation activities.
  

Financial and commercial management

* Develop and maintain robust cost estimates, annual budgets, forecasts and cash-flow profiles.
* Control project expenditure against approved funding and provide accurate monthly forecasts and variance explanations.
* Work with Procurement and Commercial teams to develop sourcing strategies, evaluate tenders and administer contracts.
* Verify supplier applications, invoices, commitments and accruals in line with delegated authority and financial controls.
* Identify and manage commercial risks, variations, claims and opportunities.

* Produce accurate project performance reporting, forecasts and management information to support governance and decision-making.
* Identify and select suppliers in line with relevant legislation and Company’s procedures.

* Ensure activities are in accordance with accounting procedures. This includes the proper authorisation and timely submission of expenses.
  

Risk, change and assurance

* Maintain project risk and opportunity registers and ensure actions have clear owners and completion dates.
* Assess and control changes to scope, cost, schedule, design and operational requirements.
* Coordinate technical reviews, constructability reviews, hazard studies and project assurance activities.
* Escalate emerging issues promptly where they may affect safety, compliance, cost, schedule or business outcomes.
  

Handover and closeout

* Ensure that commissioning, operational readiness and handover requirements are defined and planned from project inception in line with Exolums Stakeholders requests.
* Deliver complete asset records, operating documentation, training, test certification and as-built information.
* Complete financial and contractual closeout, capture lessons learned and confirm delivery of the approved project objectives.
  

Contractor Management

* Manage the performance of engineering consultants, contractors and suppliers, ensuring delivery against safety, quality, cost and schedule requirements.
* Act as Project Manager under NEC or equivalent contract arrangements and manage variations, compensation events and contractor performance.
  

**About You**

  

We are looking for a proactive and driven Project Manager with experience delivering multidisciplinary engineering or infrastructure projects within a highly regulated or safety-critical environment. You will have a proven track record of managing projects through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, alongside strong knowledge of project controls including scope, schedule, cost, risk and change management. You will be confident managing contractors, consultants and multiple work sites, building effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and communicating clearly at all levels. A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to sites across the UK is essential. Experience within the oil, gas, fuel storage, pipeline or wider major hazard sector would be advantageous, as would knowledge of COMAH, DSEAR, pipeline integrity and Management of Change processes. An engineering degree, relevant technical qualification, recognised project management qualification such as APM or PRINCE2, and Chartered or Incorporated professional status would also be beneficial.

  

**Competency model**

  

At Exolum we run a Competency Model which has been defined accordingly to our strategy, values and the geographies where we operate, making it a unique and exclusive document for Exolum. The competency Model is understood as the set of identifiable and measurable behaviours (skills, aptitudes and motivations, among others) that enable a person to achieve superior performance.

  

**We Care**- We anticipate, identify and solve the needs of our internal and external clients. - Level 4

**We Do** - We face opportunities and challenges with proactivity, energy and enthusiasm and we take responsibility for our actions - Level 3

**We Connect** - We listen, share information and communicate clearly, transparently and openly - Level 4

**We Include** - We welcome, respect and value the uniqueness of people. - Level 2

**We Get Together** -We actively collaborate with other people

### **Job Introduction**

***Join the UK’s largest B2B used vehicle service***

jobs.description:
We are growing our Cloud Infrastructure & Information Security team, and we are looking for a hands-on Cybersecurity Analyst to help us raise the bar. Security sits at the heart of how Hayfin protects its investors, its partners and its reputation.

**The Role**

You will own the day-to-day security operations of our Microsoft-native estate and act as the technical bridge between our in-house team and our managed Security Operations Centre (SOC). It is a role with real independence: you might lead an incident from first escalation to root-cause review, tune a Defender XDR detection after a threat hunt, or pull together the evidence that satisfies our ISO 27001 auditors and regulators.

You will work closely with the Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Information Security, our engineers, Compliance and Risk, and our external partners. Hayfin is a place where good ideas get heard, and you will have the room to shape the security roadmap and automate the routine so the team can focus on what matters.

**Responsibilities**

* Acting as first point of escalation from the managed SOC, leading investigation, containment and root-cause analysis for Defender XDR and Sentinel incidents
* Developing and tuning detections and KQL queries, and running threat hunts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
* Hardening our Microsoft environment across Entra ID, Intune, Defender for Endpoint and Azure, and owning the vulnerability management lifecycle
* Administering our email, web and data security controls, and running the phishing simulation and awareness programme
* Producing audit evidence and monthly security metrics for ISO 27001, FCA and DORA obligations, and supporting due diligence on vendors and portfolio companies
* Holding the managed SOC to account and contributing to the security roadmap

  
**Requirements**

You have built your career in security operations or security engineering, and you are ready to take on more ownership. You are calm under pressure, and you write as clearly as you investigate.

**You're likely to have:**

* Around 3 years' hands-on experience in a SOC, security operations or security engineering role
* Strong practical experience with Defender XDR, Sentinel, Entra ID and Intune
* Demonstrable incident response experience
* Experience working with or alongside a managed SOC or MSSP
* Clear, concise written communication, from incident reports to management-ready metrics

**It would be a bonus if you also have:**

* KQL and MITRE ATT&CK knowledge
* Microsoft SC-200, SC-100 or AZ-500 certification
* Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, and familiarity with ISO 27001, FCA or DORA
* Exposure to email and web security platforms such as Mimecast, Egress or Zscaler
* Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, Logic Apps)
* Experience supporting penetration test remediation or purple-team exercises

**Help shape how privacy is governed across our digital environment.**
======================================================================

Join the Enterprise Privacy Office as a Privacy Program Manager and help turn enterprise privacy goals into practical action. Reporting to the Chief Privacy Counsel and working under the direction of cross-functional leadership, you will manage the program, governance and platforms used to monitor, assess, and govern online privacy technologies across our websites and mobile applications.

You will bring teams together, advance strategic initiatives, and turn platform capabilities and privacy requirements into clear decisions, controls, and measurable results. This role is a strong fit for someone who can advance governance, communicate clearly, and build trusted partnerships across privacy, legal, information security, engineering, product, marketing, procurement, and business teams.

**What you’ll do:**
===================

* Turn the goals and priorities set by privacy leadership into clear roadmaps, milestones, resources, budgets, and measures of success.
* Manage the governance and day-to-day operation of online privacy technology platforms, including onboarding, configuration, access, integrations, releases, and vendor support.
* Maintain clear decision rights, intake and priority processes, committee forums, issue resolution, exceptions, and escalation paths.
* Turn platform findings into assigned actions, remove barriers, confirm updates, and manage potential risks.
* Keep a current view of covered websites and mobile applications, owners, platform status, open issues, and dependencies.

* Support and participate in privacy impact assessments for new and changing online privacy technologies.
* Provide clear reporting on program progress, platform coverage, findings, aging, exceptions, control performance, and resource needs.
* Manage platform providers, product roadmaps, support, licensing, contracts, budgets, deliverables, and performance.
* Improve the program by simplifying work, strengthening data quality, automating repeatable tasks, and embedding privacy into digital initiatives.

* At least 7+ of experience leading complex privacy, technology, security, compliance, digital, or enterprise programs.

new_jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike is seeking a passionate and strategic Sr. Competitive Intelligence Analyst III to support our Security for AI portfolio, including AI Detection and Response (AIDR), securing generative AI applications, and protecting autonomous agents. In this role, you will partner directly with Product, Sales, and cross-functional leaders to inform roadmap decisions, guide go-to-market strategy, and help CrowdStrike win in a rapidly evolving competitive landscape focused on securing the enterprise AI ecosystem against emerging threats like prompt injection and data leakage.

You will develop a deep, nuanced understanding of how competitors approach Security for AI, analyzing their ability to protect prompts, models, and agents, as well as the real reasons CrowdStrike wins or loses in the field. This work will scale globally and require tight partnership with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations, and other teams.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical proficiency in AI/ML for cybersecurity, practical insight into real-world security product development, and the ability to translate complex analysis into actionable guidance. This is a remote, individual-contributor role with significant visibility and impact.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Synthesize and formulate guidance on the strategic importance of Security for AI, emphasizing how the protection of autonomous agents and the mitigation of prompt-based threats create a significant competitive advantage.
* Provide a field-actionable, in-depth and ever-evolving understanding of the Security for AI market, analyzing competitors' ability to deliver accelerated detection and autonomous remediation across the full AI lifecycle.
* Provide tailored deal support (competitive surgeries & guidance), and develop a deep rapport with the field.
* Work closely with the rest of the Competitive Intelligence team and technical stakeholders to serve as the primary liaison for Security for AI competition.
* Make recommendations on sales tactics and product strategy to enable CrowdStrike to win in the market.
* Be a self-starter with an ownership mentality. You will work autonomously in the development of project plans, requirements, timelines, content, and ongoing tracking/updates of the Security for AI competitive landscape.
* Conduct win/loss analysis, using both quantitative and qualitative data sources to determine why CrowdStrike wins and loses vs. the competition.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field (Computer Science, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related discipline).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the cybersecurity market with a primary focus on Security for AI/ML, including demonstrated understanding of AI/LLM attack surfaces (e.g., prompt injection, model poisoning, training data leakage) and AI governance.
* Deep familiarity with the Security for AI competitive landscape, including major industry players, AI safety frameworks, and the evolving regulatory environment.
* Minimum of 5 years relevant work experience (Ideal candidates will have experience in at least TWO of the following): sales engineer/pre-sales, competitive intelligence, solution architect, product management, technical marketing, and product marketing
* Proven ability to synthesize complex technical concepts related to AI threats and security into field-actionable guidance and executive summaries.
* Superior communication skills including experience presenting to senior & executive level management.
* Excellent people and project management skills to manage initiatives and build rapport with cross-functional teams and third parties.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Relevant certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, or specialized cybersecurity fields.
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI in a security context.
* Direct experience with customers (as a customer, or in a customer support or field role) selling or supporting security products.

new_jobs.description:
Five Sigma is an AI-native InsurTech company transforming the insurance claims management industry. Our cloud-based Claims Management Platform enables insurance carriers and organizations to streamline operations, automate workflows, and make smarter, data-driven decisions.

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Business & Data Analyst** to join our Global Delivery team.

You will work directly with US-based insurance customers to translate complex business requirements and data into functional solutions within Five Sigma's Claims Management Platform.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role combining business analysis, data investigation, functional solution design, and validation throughout the implementation lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Functional Design**

* Lead discovery sessions with insurance customers to understand their claims operations, workflows, business rules, and challenges.
* Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify edge cases, business exceptions, and gaps in customer requirements.
* Map business requirements to Five Sigma's platform capabilities and define appropriate configurations.
* Partner with Delivery Managers and technical implementation teams to evaluate solution approaches.

**Data Analysis & Integration**

* Analyze customer data structures, quality, and business meaning.
* Own source-to-target data mappings, transformation rules, and reconciliation criteria.
* Support data migrations, integrations, and reporting requirements.
* Use SQL to investigate datasets, identify inconsistencies, and validate results.
* Ensure data accuracy and alignment with customer business processes.

**Testing & Validation**

* Define business test scenarios and expected outcomes.
* Validate configurations, workflows, calculations, reports, and migrated data.
* Support UAT and troubleshoot functional and data-related issues.
* Ensure the delivered solution meets agreed business requirements.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with customers, Delivery Managers, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Maintain clear documentation of requirements, mappings, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate complex findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Remain actively involved from discovery through go-live.

  
Requirements:
  

* 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Business & Data Analyst in a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
* Experience in US Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance, claims management, or insurance technology.
* Familiarity with claims workflows, policy administration, and insurance data.
* Experience with enterprise software implementations, data migration, and system integrations.
* Proven ability to translate complex business processes into functional requirements and specifications.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote, global environment.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with APIs, JSON, ETL processes, and data reconciliation.
* Experience implementing configurable enterprise SaaS platforms.

### **Why Five Sigma?**

Join a fast-growing global InsurTech company where your work directly impacts how insurance organizations operate. You'll collaborate with talented professionals, solve meaningful business challenges, and help shape the future of AI-powered claims management.

**Join us and help transform the insurance industry.**

new_jobs.title: Healthcare Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Healthcare Data Analyst**

*Analytics Team*

**Position Summary**

The Healthcare Data Analyst supports recurring healthcare utilization, quality, access, financial, and operational analysis in partnership with senior analysts and cross-functional stakeholders. This role analyzes and interprets healthcare data and reporting related to claims, eligibility, encounters, service utilization, care patterns, population trends, and client or payer performance. Using Power BI, established reporting processes, and appropriate data-validation methods, the analyst identifies meaningful trends and drivers, evaluates performance, and communicates accurate, timely insights that inform operational planning, program evaluation, and healthcare decision-making.

**Responsibilities**

· Analyze recurring healthcare reports—including claims, eligibility, encounters, service utilization, access, volume, quality, and trend summaries—to identify meaningful patterns, variances, and emerging issues; validate results using established quality-control processes and communicate decision-ready insights.

· Utilize Power BI dashboards and recurring reporting packages that track key utilization, access, quality, operational, population, and client performance metrics.

· Root-cause analysis of changes in utilization patterns, service trends, member or patient activity, access indicators, population characteristics, and payer or client performance to identify meaningful changes and opportunities.

· Fulfill well-scoped ad hoc analysis requests by extracting defined data sets, applying approved logic, and summarizing findings in a clear, organized, and decision-ready format.

· Validate the consistency of claims, eligibility, encounter, utilization, quality, and operational results across internal systems, client files, payer reports, and dashboard outputs; investigate material discrepancies and document their impact on reported findings.

· Partner with Clinical, Operations, Data Management, Population Health, Client Services, and other stakeholders to provide accurate, timely analytical support; perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

· 2–3 years of experience in healthcare data analysis, population health, managed care, health plan, provider, or related analytics.

· Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, health informatics, data analytics, statistics, or a related field required.

· Proficiency in Excel required, including formulas, logical functions, lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.

· Power BI user-level experience strongly preferred, including building new queries, calculated fields, and report development.

· Ability to evaluate healthcare data for accuracy, identify outliers or inconsistencies, follow defined quality-control procedures, and ask thoughtful questions when results do not align with expectations.

· Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage recurring reporting and analytical deadlines.

· Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain healthcare data, trends, methods, and issues to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Working knowledge of healthcare claims, eligibility, encounters, utilization, quality measures, or managed care concepts, with an eagerness to deepen expertise in healthcare analytics.

**Requirements**

· Residence within the Continental United States

· Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

* Process adherence and escalation judgment: following documented procedures precisely and recognizing when to escalate

This includes being able to assess and mitigate system security threats and risks, validate system security requirements, analyze and collaborate on system security designs, verify compliance with system security requirements, manage the complete internal and external assessment and audit lifecycle, testing, and act as a liaison with other departments and business units to support ongoing system security operations and maintenance. You will evaluate the suitability of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-backed products for Federal regulated industry customers and you will leverage AI to build automations which will allow Datadog to demonstrate compliance with current and future requirements.

new_jobs.description:
**TL;DR** **TL;DR** Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.
  
  
Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

  

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

  

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

  

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Update existing research while monitoring developments on sanctions issues, regulatory environments, and other national security or compliance-related matters.
* Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
* Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
* Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
* Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
* At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
* Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
* High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

### **BENEFITS:**

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

* Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
* FSA program for both medical and dependent care
* 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
* Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $65,000-$75,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com to apply.

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

**Compensation:** $65,000 - $75,000 / year

* Communicating the impact of clinical and operational performance on public reporting, organizational reputation, patient outcomes, quality ratings, and financial performance.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading and managing all new business opportunities associated with the design and deployment of advanced wireless network solutions, including Indoor Distributed Antenna Systems (iDAS), Outdoor Distributed Antenna Systems (oDAS), Small Cell networks, and WiFi infrastructure. This individual serves as the primary project lead from opportunity identification through proposal development, customer engagement, planning, and project handoff for execution.
  
  
The role requires a highly experienced subject matter expert with deep knowledge of wireless network design, construction methodologies, and deployment practices for both indoor and outdoor environments. The Senior Project Manager will develop comprehensive construction scopes of work, prepare accurate cost estimates, evaluate deployment risks, and ensure proposed solutions are aligned with technical, operational, and financial objectives.
  
  
Working directly with venue owners, property management teams, and key customer stakeholders, the Senior Project Manager will lead discussions regarding site requirements, deployment strategies, construction logistics, approval processes, and implementation planning necessary to support RF design objectives. This individual must possess exceptional communication and relationship management skills to build trust, drive alignment, and facilitate timely decision-making.
  
  
The Senior Project Manager will collaborate closely with RF Engineering, Real Estate, Construction, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to develop scalable and cost-effective solutions. The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to influence and drive teams across organizational boundaries, balance competing priorities, and ensure opportunities progress efficiently from concept through execution readiness.
  
In addition to leading opportunity development efforts, the Senior Project Manager may be assigned responsibility for the full execution of select projects following contract award. new_jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

#### **The Role**

The Partnerships department operates in a fast-paced environment with a lean team. Key priorities arise from major events like SKO or Forge Partner Day, cross-functional initiatives, and urgent executive inquiries. Top-tier partnership teams require a dedicated program manager to own these priorities, drive execution, and maintain clear visibility into project status, blockers, and ownership.

Operating across the entire department rather than within a single partner segment, this role collaborates across every functional pillar. Key responsibilities centre on establishing clear workstream visibility and managing high-priority ad-hoc projects. This includes maintaining an accurate single source of truth for ongoing department initiatives, supporting program management for flagship events such as SKO, Forge Partner Day, and the departmental kick-off, and partnering closely with the AVP, Partner Experience to maintain the departmental operating rhythm—encompassing OKRs, business reviews, strategic narratives, All Hands meetings, and internal communications.

Rapid growth has outpaced formal tracking, leaving initiatives reliant on informal ownership and tracking. We need a program manager to establish structure, seamlessly manage diverse workstreams, and build lasting, repeatable processes. Success is defined by delivering high-quality projects on time and maintaining clear, transparent visibility into overall department status.

#### **What You'll Own**

* **Workstream visibility.** Maintain one view of cross-departmental initiatives: owners, status, dependencies and risks, with Jira as the source of truth. Run regular check-ins that keep it honest, raise concerns before they become surprises, and give leadership a clear picture of what is moving and what is not.
* **Ad-hoc and flagship projects.** Take projects from brief to delivery: agree scope and owners, build the plan, chase the dependencies, manage the timeline and run the follow-up.
* **Company moments such as SKO and Forge Partner Day.** Support the Partnerships contribution to events where the department is on stage. This may include working with leadership on the narrative and theme, briefing speakers, gathering content from pillar leads and coordinating with Marketing and Events.
* **Cross-functional initiatives.** Drive initiatives that cut across teams and need a single owner for delivery, such as moving a process from one team to another or launching a change that touches several pillars. Clarify who does what, keep the work moving and close it out properly.
* **Operating rhythm.** Support the department's OKRs, monthly and quarterly business reviews, quarterly narratives and monthly All Hands. Build the trackers and templates, chase inputs, prepare pre-reads and help run the sessions, so that leaders spend their time on decisions.
* **Communications and PR-FAQs.** Support the cadence of department updates and the PR-FAQ tracker for major launches, so that format, tone and timing stay consistent and status is honest.
* **Planning and engagement.** Support the SVP, Partnerships and Partner Operations team with annual planning, and the follow-up from the employee engagement survey in Culture Amp: tracking actions through to completion and reporting back on what changed.
* **Salesforce alignment.** If the acquisition of Braze by Salesforce completes, help plan and track the work to bring the Braze partner program in line with the broader Salesforce partner program and ecosystem, and keep it visible alongside everything else in flight.

#### **What This Role Is Really About**

A department our size can't hire a specialist for every function, and shouldn't. What it needs is someone who can pick up whatever matters most this month, run it properly and leave something behind that works without them. One month that is the narrative and run of show for Forge Partner Day. The next it is an initiative that three teams each assume another team owns. The through-line is visibility: whatever you are working on, people can see where it stands.

You will not own the content or the decisions. Pillar leads own their numbers and their stories, and leadership owns the choices. You own the delivery and the clarity around it. That means asking the question that exposes a gap in a plan, noticing when a deadline will slip a week before it does, and telling a leader that their narrative buries the lead. You do this without formal authority, and you earn trust by making everyone else's job easier.

You will also see things that are sensitive: survey results, plans in progress, changes to the organisation. Discretion is part of the job.

* **Drives ownership to completion.** You step in to claim unassigned initiatives, assign clear accountability, and steer them through to successful execution.
* **Communicates with clarity and impact.** You distill complex upda

### **Description**

**TL;DR** **TL;DR** Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.  
  
Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Update existing research while monitoring developments on sanctions issues, regulatory environments, and other national security or compliance-related matters.
* Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
* Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
* Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

  

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
* Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
* At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
* Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
* High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

  

### **BENEFITS:**

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

* Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
* FSA program for both medical and dependent care
* 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
* Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $65,000-$75,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com to apply.

##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton's Physical Security team is responsible for the safety and security of all Peraton facilities across the enterprise. The team delivers this mission through electronic access control systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV) and video management systems, intrusion detection, contracted guard services, visitor management, and ongoing physical security assessments. The team also plays a central role in Peraton's growth activities, forecasting physical security costs associated with new facility buildouts, program captures, and proposal efforts.

We are seeking a Physical Security Analyst to join the team as a junior-level individual contributor. This is a developmental role designed for someone with foundational experience in physical security, facilities, or a related security field who is looking to grow into a well-rounded physical security professional. The analyst will support the team's day-to-day operations as well as its proposal and growth activities, working alongside senior team members on real-world projects from day one.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Physical Security Operations Support**

* Support day-to-day administration of enterprise physical security systems, including access control, CCTV/video management, visitor management, and intrusion detection

* Monitor and triage physical security alarms and events; escalate as appropriate
* Support investigations into facility-related security incidents and compile supporting documentation
* Help maintain accurate inventories of physical security equipment, cameras, readers, and related assets

----------------------------------

* Help coordinate day-to-day interactions with contracted guard service providers
* Review guard post orders, patrol logs, and incident reports for completeness
* Assist with guard scheduling coordination and documentation of post requirements
* Support site visits and quality checks of guard operations

* Research vendor pricing for access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and related physical security equipment
* Help maintain reusable pricing templates, standardized bills of materials, and historical cost data
* Compile physical security sections of proposal narratives under the direction of senior team members
* Participate in site surveys of candidate facilities and document findings

**Documentation & Reporting**
-----------------------------

* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), site-specific security plans, and system documentation
* Prepare periodic reports on access control activity, incidents, and system health
* Support audits, physical security assessments, and compliance reviews
* Maintain organized project files and documentation for proposal and buildout efforts

**Collaboration**
-----------------

* Partner with Facilities, IT, Program Security, and HR teams on cross-functional efforts
* Interact professionally with employees, contractors, and visitors regarding physical security matters
* Participate in team meetings, project reviews, and ongoing training

##### **Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Homeland Security, Security Management, Business, or a related field —
* At least 1 year of experience in physical security, facility security, law enforcement, military security operations, or a closely related role
* 6+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Working familiarity with physical security concepts: access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, visitor management, and guard operations
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office — particularly Excel (for pricing/cost work), Word, and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
* US Citizenship required
* Ability to obtain a secret security clearance.
* Ability to work on-site at Peraton facilities as needed and travel occasionally to other Peraton locations

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Hands-on experience with any enterprise access control platform (e.g., Lenel, AMAG, Software House/C•CURE, Genetec, Avigilon)
* Familiarity with any video management system (e.g., Milestone, Genetec, Avigilon, Salient)
* Experience supporting proposals, pricing, or cost estimates in a government contracting environment
* Exposure to physical security standards — UL 2050, DoD / IC construction standards, ICD 705 fundamentals, or RMF controls (CP, PE families)
* Prior experience interacting with contracted guard services
* Active or prior security clearance (Secret or higher)
* Industry certifications such as PSP

* Support administrative updates for project codes impacting procurement routing, revenue tracking, or reporting workflows.

  Strong attention to detail and comfort verifying documentation.

HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. **Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, highly organised Business Operations Manager to own day-to-day operations across the business. This hands-on management role requires forward planning, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Projects and Service are key priorities, alongside procurement, logistics, resource planning, business support and compliance. The remit includes social media coordination, but not broader marketing strategy or delivery.

**Making the world** **Move**

  

Exolum are an innovative fuel storage company with the priority of a green energy future operating globally. People are at the heart our expansion plans with a focus on developing our colleagues to reach their potential while accepting everyone as they are!

  

**Project Manager- Flexible site location- Permanent**

  

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Asset Technology team. Reporting to the Pipeline Systems Project Portfolio Manager, you will be responsible for the safe, compliant and effective delivery of engineering projects across Exolum's investment programme. You will manage projects through the full lifecycle, from concept development and business case preparation through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and closeout.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, contractors and suppliers, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with regulatory requirements and Exolum governance standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Capital Project Delivery

* Deliver engineering investment projects from concept through to asset handover in accordance with Exolum's Capital Project Delivery Process.
* Develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules and business cases to support investment decisions.
* Manage multidisciplinary engineering, procurement and construction activities.
* Ensure completed assets are safely integrated into operations and transferred to the asset owner with all supporting documentation.
* Support annual investment planning and portfolio prioritisation activities.
  

Financial and commercial management

* Develop and maintain robust cost estimates, annual budgets, forecasts and cash-flow profiles.
* Control project expenditure against approved funding and provide accurate monthly forecasts and variance explanations.
* Work with Procurement and Commercial teams to develop sourcing strategies, evaluate tenders and administer contracts.
* Verify supplier applications, invoices, commitments and accruals in line with delegated authority and financial controls.
* Identify and manage commercial risks, variations, claims and opportunities.

* Produce accurate project performance reporting, forecasts and management information to support governance and decision-making.
* Identify and select suppliers in line with relevant legislation and Company’s procedures.

* Ensure activities are in accordance with accounting procedures. This includes the proper authorisation and timely submission of expenses.
  

Risk, change and assurance

* Maintain project risk and opportunity registers and ensure actions have clear owners and completion dates.
* Assess and control changes to scope, cost, schedule, design and operational requirements.
* Coordinate technical reviews, constructability reviews, hazard studies and project assurance activities.
* Escalate emerging issues promptly where they may affect safety, compliance, cost, schedule or business outcomes.
  

Handover and closeout

* Ensure that commissioning, operational readiness and handover requirements are defined and planned from project inception in line with Exolums Stakeholders requests.
* Deliver complete asset records, operating documentation, training, test certification and as-built information.
* Complete financial and contractual closeout, capture lessons learned and confirm delivery of the approved project objectives.
  

Contractor Management

* Manage the performance of engineering consultants, contractors and suppliers, ensuring delivery against safety, quality, cost and schedule requirements.
* Act as Project Manager under NEC or equivalent contract arrangements and manage variations, compensation events and contractor performance.
  

**About You**

  

We are looking for a proactive and driven Project Manager with experience delivering multidisciplinary engineering or infrastructure projects within a highly regulated or safety-critical environment. You will have a proven track record of managing projects through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, alongside strong knowledge of project controls including scope, schedule, cost, risk and change management. You will be confident managing contractors, consultants and multiple work sites, building effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and communicating clearly at all levels. A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to sites across the UK is essential. Experience within the oil, gas, fuel storage, pipeline or wider major hazard sector would be advantageous, as would knowledge of COMAH, DSEAR, pipeline integrity and Management of Change processes. An engineering degree, relevant technical qualification, recognised project management qualification such as APM or PRINCE2, and Chartered or Incorporated professional status would also be beneficial.

  

**Competency model**

  

At Exolum we run a Competency Model which has been defined accordingly to our strategy, values and the geographies where we operate, making it a unique and exclusive document for Exolum. The competency Model is understood as the set of identifiable and measurable behaviours (skills, aptitudes and motivations, among others) that enable a person to achieve superior performance.

  

**We Care**- We anticipate, identify and solve the needs of our internal and external clients. - Level 4

**We Do** - We face opportunities and challenges with proactivity, energy and enthusiasm and we take responsibility for our actions - Level 3

**We Connect** - We listen, share information and communicate clearly, transparently and openly - Level 4

**We Include** - We welcome, respect and value the uniqueness of people. - Level 2

**We Get Together** -We actively collaborate with other people

--------------------

This is a key role in supporting the delivery of Selfridges’ strategic Masterplan projects. You’ll provide day-to-day project management, governance, reporting, planning and coordination support across multiple programmes and workstreams along with governance support across projects and operational activities, manage key contract administration processes, and coordinate between internal teams and external partners. * Own end-to-end customer implementations, from kickoff and project planning through go-live and post-launch support.
* Manage approximately 7–10 concurrent implementation projects, maintaining timelines, milestones, resources, and deliverables.
* Lead customer meetings, communicate project status, manage escalations, and proactively address delivery risks.
* Coordinate integrations involving core banking, online banking, lending, credit card, and related financial technology platforms.
* Partner with Solutions Architects, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to resolve technical issues and deliver successful launches.
* Track implementation defects, dependencies, and product changes through resolution.
* Manage a 2–4 week post-launch hypercare period to support stabilization and customer readiness.

* Improve deployment processes as self-service tools and AI capabilities evolve.
* Use AI productivity tools to improve project planning, documentation, communication, and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in Technical Project Management, software implementation, or enterprise technology delivery.
* Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end B2B SaaS implementations within enterprise or mid-market customer environments.
* Experience managing project timelines, dependencies, risks, customer expectations, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including direct customer engagement.
* Ability to build and improve implementation processes without relying on an established playbook.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Ability to work on-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing software for credit unions, community banks, or other financial institutions.
* Familiarity with core banking systems, online banking platforms, lending technology, or financial services integrations.
* Exposure to conversational AI, voice AI, agentic AI, or contact center technology.

* Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with Product and Engineering teams.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Performance bonus of 10%, tied to implementation launch success.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums fully covered by the employer.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Discretionary paid time off.
* Opportunity to help establish and scale a dedicated customer implementation function.
